Configure nested Tesseract and PaddleOCR settings in a multi-backend pipeline

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    val input = mapper.readValue("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"text/plain\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/text/report.txt\"}", ExtractInput::class.java)
    val config = mapper.readValue("{\"ocr\":{\"enabled\":false,\"pipeline\":{\"quality_thresholds\":{},\"stages\":[{\"backend\":\"tesseract\",\"priority\":100,\"tesseract_config\":{\"enable_table_detection\":false,\"psm\":6}},{\"backend\":\"paddleocr\",\"paddle_ocr_settings\":{\"enable_table_detection\":true,\"model_tier\":\"server\",\"use_angle_cls\":true},\"priority\":90}]}},\"url\":{\"crawl\":{\"ssrf\":{}}}}", ExtractionConfig::class.java)
    val result = Xberg.extract(input, config)
    println(result.results.first().mimeType)
    println(result.results.first().content)
}
```
